newsitem.title: UK: Xenova surges on Zeneca linkup.
newsitem.headline: Xenova surges on Zeneca linkup.

text.p: Xenova Group Plc shares surged on Wednesday after the company said it agreed with Zeneca Group Plc to collaborate in the discovery of novel pharmaceuticals for its natural compound libraries, dealers said.
AT 0939 GMT, shares in Xenova were up 50p, or 14 percent, to 405p, having scored a record peak at 413p just after the announcement was made.
Shares in Zeneca, meanwhile, climbed 8-1/2p to 1787-1/2.
"This could put Xenova in a new league," said one dealer of the group's link with the UK pharmaceutical giant.

Under the terms of the agreement, Xenova, which posted 1996 revenues of 1.59 million stg, would be eligible for milestone payments and royalties on drugs developed by Zeneca from its libraries, the company said nFLLF3J01P. --London newsroom +44 171 542 5106
